findings.title: Password-reset emails delayed up to 30 minutes during peak usage hours
findings.description: Beacon Point's leadership-tier users (infrequent loggers) report password-reset emails taking up to 30 minutes to arrive, versus the expected near-instant delivery. The customer has about a dozen examples from the last two months, with the worst (full 30-minute) delays clustering at weekday midday and busy Saturday mornings. The delay spans multiple recipient providers (personal Gmail and the marina's own domain), ruling out a provider- or spam-filter-side cause and pointing to sending-side queuing under load. The reset link itself works correctly once the email arrives; workaround given was to request once, wait, and avoid re-requesting.
findings.quote: And then the email doesn't come. Or rather — it comes, eventually, but not for like half an hour.
findings.severity_reason: Blocks timely login/session access for affected users but a workaround exists (wait for the email, or reset ahead of time); already a tracked Open bug reflecting known but non-critical impact.
findings.match_note: Same symptom (reset email delay up to ~30 min) and same scope (worse during peak/busy hours) as PROJ-142's peak-hour email queuing behind bulk sends.

findings.title: N/A — SSO raised by support engineer, not requested first-hand by customer
findings.description: Support engineer Ravi suggested SSO as a long-term fix for the infrequent-login/forgotten-password pattern. Delia confirmed Beacon Point currently has no SSO and expressed casual curiosity ('interesting thought'), but did not ask for it as a product change — she said it 'might be more than we want to take on' and only wants to hear what it would involve. No firm ask was made by the customer.
findings.quote: But that's an interesting thought. Is that something you all support?
findings.severity_reason: No concrete customer ask exists; this is an unprompted, non-committal inquiry into an idea introduced by support staff, not a stated product gap the customer wants closed.
findings.match_note: Fails the 'external raises it first-hand' bar — SSO was introduced by INTERNAL Ravi at L48 as a suggestion; Delia only reacted with curiosity and did not request it.
